run_train_loop: run the train function to train a PyTorch model with loss tracking and checkpointing
save_checkpoint_model: save a PyTorch model and optimizer state dict to a checkpoint file on disk
load_checkpoint_model: load a PyTorch model and optimizer state dict from a checkpoint file
process_losses_dict: preprocess a dictionary of loss values by stripping prefixes and reducing to scalars
filter_inputs_model: filter a batch of input tensors to only include names required by the model
